visualCharacteristics.purpose: Horizontal in-page jump-link bar (e.g. Key Features, Banking Fees, How to Open) linking to sections of the same page

contentPattern.structure: One or more rows whose cells hold links (a list of links or one link per cell); all links are collected into one horizontal list. Rows with no links are kept as plain side-by-side text cells

reuseGuidance: Use for in-page anchor links to sections on the same page. Use section-nav for sidebar/tab navigation across related pages. Member v_2a0fdf8cfa4e (light option) is a single fee label/value row that looks closer to columns-feature-row; consider reclassifying it with excat-catalog-manager.
